resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Tuple Unpacking[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]Tuple unpacking[/b] allows you to assign each item in a collection to a variable.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="446"]numbers = (1, 2, 3)
[b]a, b, c = numbers[/b]
print(a)
print(b)
print(c)[/code]
[note]This can be also used to swap variables by doing[b] a, b = b, a [/b], since[b] b, a[/b] on the right hand side forms the tuple[b] (b, a) [/b]which is then unpacked.[/note]

resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Tuple Unpacking[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A variable that is prefaced with an asterisk (*) takes all values from the collection that are left over from the other variables.

[s0l0!-header][b]Example:[/b][/s0l0!-header][code format="py" codeId="447"]a, b, [b]*c[/b], d = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]
print(a)
print(b)
print(c)
print(d)[/code]
[note][b]c[/b] will get assigned the values 3 to 8.[/note]

resolved.title: 距离计算器
resolved.problem_statement_md:
你正在开发一个地图软件。
地图为一些列坐标组成，并存储在列表中，其中每项表示为一个元组，包含了该点的X和Y坐标。

你需要计算并输出离点`(0,0)`最近的点的距离。

要计算点`(x,y)`与`(0,0)`的距离，使用以下公式：**(x²+y²)^1/2^**
resolved.problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Tuple Unpacking[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You are working on a mapping software. The map is stored as a list of points, where each item is represented as a tuple, containing the X and Y coordinates of the point.
You need to calculate and output the distance to the closest point from the point (0, 0).
To calculate the distance of the point (x, y) from (0, 0), use the following formula: [b]√x²+y²[/b]
[note]You can iterate over the list and use tuple unpacking to get the x and y coordinates of each point: [b]for (x, y) in points: [/b]and output the smallest value.[/note]
resolved.hint_md:
你可以遍历该列表，并使用元组解包来获得每个点的x和y坐标。
**for (x, y) in points:** 并输出最端距离。

code_templates.solution_code:
import math
points = [
  (12, 55),
  (880, 123),
  (64, 64),
  (190, 1024),
  (77, 33),
  (42, 11),
  (0, 90)
 ]
distance = list(range(len(points)))
 
z = 0
for (x,y) in points:
    distance[z] = math.sqrt((x**2) + (y**2))
    z += 1
 
print(min(distance))
